news.headline: Jones failed to eclipse the 200-yard mark for the fourth straight game while throwing multiple picks for the second time
news.detail: Jones failed to eclipse the 200-yard mark for the fourth straight game while throwing multiple picks for the second time in that span. Neither turnover led to any Dolphins points, and Jones also threw a seven-yard touchdown pass to new interim No. 1 receiver Laquon Treadwell in the second quarter. J
